name: CyberSec Toolkit
description: AI-powered network recon and vulnerability scanning platform, nmap plus Shodan plus an AI analyst in one tool.
coverAlt: 3D desktop monitor mockup displaying the CyberSec cybersecurity platform website with an AI-powered vulnerability scanning dashboard in a dark purple interface.

designDecisions.title: Signal before surface
designDecisions.description: The interface puts scan status, severity, and the next useful action ahead of decorative dashboard chrome.

designDecisions.title: A readable threat model
designDecisions.description: Findings are grouped by asset and severity so the product can be understood quickly during an active investigation.

designDecisions.title: One analyst voice
designDecisions.description: AI explanations sit beside the underlying evidence, keeping the recommendation useful without hiding the source of the signal.

developmentDecisions.title: Composable scan pipeline
developmentDecisions.description: Reconnaissance, enrichment, and analysis are treated as separate steps so each part can evolve without reshaping the whole product.

developmentDecisions.title: Actionable results
developmentDecisions.description: The result model keeps raw findings connected to severity, affected assets, and remediation context.

developmentDecisions.title: Make the expensive work visible
developmentDecisions.description: Long-running scans communicate their state clearly, so users always know what is running and what is ready to review.

name: Designer's Room
description: A roadmap-driven learning and community platform for designers: follow structured guidebooks like UI/UX Designer, learn topic by topic, and share thoughts and experiences with other designers. Think roadmap.sh meets TryHackMe, built for design.
coverAlt: 3D laptop mockup showcasing the Designer's Room platform with a guidebook roadmap page and community feed, in a clean modern interface.

designDecisions.title: Progress is the primary navigation
designDecisions.description: The roadmap gives learning a visible shape, making the next step easier to find than a loose collection of resources.

designDecisions.title: Reading before reacting
designDecisions.description: Guidebook content gets a calm, focused layout while community contributions remain close enough to add context.

designDecisions.title: A system that can grow
designDecisions.description: The visual language uses repeatable type, spacing, and status patterns so new topics feel part of one product.

developmentDecisions.title: Content as structured data
developmentDecisions.description: Roadmaps, topics, and progress states are modeled independently so the same learning system can support multiple guidebooks.

developmentDecisions.title: Useful state at every step
developmentDecisions.description: The product makes unfinished, current, and completed topics distinguishable without relying on color alone.

developmentDecisions.title: Community with a clear boundary
developmentDecisions.description: The discussion layer is connected to learning context, keeping conversation attached to the topic rather than becoming a separate feed.

name: Notify-ED
description: Instant multi-channel grade notification platform for colleges: upload a roster, enter marks, and students get Email, WhatsApp and in-app alerts with delivery tracking.
coverAlt: 3D laptop mockup showcasing the Notifyed student grade notification platform website with automated email and WhatsApp alerts, featuring a clean cream and orange interface.

designDecisions.title: A short path to send
designDecisions.description: The flow is organized around the real task: upload a roster, review the marks, and send with confidence.

designDecisions.title: Trust in the review step
designDecisions.description: Recipient counts, channel choices, and message previews are visible before a notification leaves the system.

designDecisions.title: Operational clarity
designDecisions.description: Delivery states are designed to be scanned quickly, helping staff spot what succeeded and what needs attention.

developmentDecisions.title: One source, many channels
developmentDecisions.description: A shared notification model keeps email, WhatsApp, and in-app delivery aligned while allowing channel-specific handling.

developmentDecisions.title: Import with guardrails
developmentDecisions.description: Roster parsing is treated as a validation step, surfacing problems before they become partial or misdirected sends.

developmentDecisions.title: Delivery you can audit
developmentDecisions.description: Each notification preserves enough status context to understand its outcome after the initial send.
